# Riprap

> Pooled cover on Solana, settled by peers. Any group can start a payout pool — mutual cover for what goes wrong, bounties for verified acts; risk capital and yield on the roadmap. Peer jurors adjudicate claims, unused funds return to members pro-rata, finite pools dissolve. Pre-launch.

Riprap is a protocol for payout pools on Solana: any group chips into one pot on terms it sets itself — pooled cover is the first market. In a cover pool, members pay a fixed entry fee against one narrowly defined peril; a qualifying incident is adjudicated by jurors drawn from the pool's own staked members (adjudication runs on Accord, a Schelling-point arbitration protocol; voting coherently with the honest majority is the profitable strategy). Approved claims pay out of the pool; payouts are capped twice, by the member's tier and by the pool's balance. When the claims window closes, every unused cent returns to members pro-rata and the pool dissolves permanently. A bounty pool is the same rails pointed the other way: it pays for verified acts instead of losses. No insurer, no reserve, no retained profit. Roadmap: outside risk capital stakes into pools and earns a rule-set share of the surplus — insurance, rebuilt as rails.

Money leaves a pool through exactly two governed doors: spending (adjudicated claims) and liquidation. There is no third exit and no discretionary signer.

## Pages

- [Platform landing](https://riprap.xyz/): what a peer-to-peer risk pool is, the mutuals directory, the five-step lifecycle, ten honest FAQ answers, waitlist. The peril never appears in the platform copy; the directory cards carry each pool's own peril, per its policy.
- [Mutuals](https://riprap.xyz/#/mutuals): the tabular pool directory — every pool with what it covers, its entry fees, and its maximum payouts. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.
- [Pool details](https://riprap.xyz/#/m/blade-pool): every pool resolves at #/m/<mutual-pubkey-or-slug> — the Blade Pool's full policy page (legacy #/2026-breakpoint-blade-pool route kept), and a placeholder detail page per draft pool (definition, exclusions, claims proof, worked math, the end) extracted from its policy/terms document. Hash routes: render client-side from the landing document.
- [App](https://riprap.xyz/#/app): the member wallet surface — join and claims, reading on-chain pool state. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.
- [File a payout request](https://riprap.xyz/#/app/file-claim): the payout-request wizard — the incident, the five required proofs, one on-chain claim. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.
- [Adjudicate](https://riprap.xyz/#/app/adjudicate): the juror surface — drawn seats, the evidence, one commit-reveal vote. Hash route: renders client-side from the landing document.

## Pools in the first batch (Breakpoint 2026)

- Blade Pool — knife assault cover: bodily injury caused by another person with a knife or blade during the conference. Tiers: $10/$20/$40 entry, up to $1,000/$2,000/$4,000 payout (final). Live surface: the pool page above.
- NGMI Hairline — new gray hair first visible during the conference, graded I–IV ("a countable few" to "basically Gandalf"). Fixed $25 entry, up to $200 payout; grades pay $20/$60/$100/$200 — 10/30/50/100% of the maximum (final, policy §5).
- OnlyFriends (bounty) — confirmed introductions of a member to a listed VIP, paid per introduction. Draft: $25 entry, $15 per intro up to $150 (TODO-confirm in terms).
- Operation Keep Raj Warm / Lily's Liquid Lifeline / Toly Needs His Fuel (bounties) — bring the named person (Raj Gokal, Lily Liu, Anatoly Yakovenko) a hot drink they asked for, hand to hand, still hot, confirmed by them. Draft: $5 entry, $50 bounty each (TODO-confirm in terms). Bounties share no risk — they pay for verified acts on the same rails as the mutuals.
- Mert of the Year (bounty) — hand Mert Mumtaz an over-the-top trophy bearing the required inscription ("For Outstanding Contributions to Making Solana Developers Less Miserable."), delivered with a completely serious thirty-second acceptance speech on his behalf, notified on X tagging @riprapxyz; the bounty pays the one trophy he declares best after the conference. $10 entry, $1000 bounty (final, terms §5; his consent and the adjudication fee are TODO in the terms).

## Policy: Blade Pool @ Breakpoint 2026 (the first pool)

- Peril: knife assault — bodily injury caused by another person intentionally using a knife or bladed instrument against the member.
- Coverage window: 15–17 November 2026 — opens with the conference, closes with the conference (daily hours per the published event schedule).
- Covered area: Olympia Convention Centre and designated event area, London.
- Tiers: Basic $10 entry, max payout $1,000 · Standard $20 entry, max payout $2,000 · Premium $40 entry, max payout $4,000. The max payout is the total a member can receive for qualifying claims from the covered event.
- Exclusions (not covered): injuries caused by the member themselves; accidental injuries involving a knife or blade; ordinary handling or use of a knife; consensual activities; incidents outside the coverage period; incidents outside the covered area; emotional distress without qualifying bodily injury; claims exceeding the member's tier maximum.
- Claims: a member files a claim with evidence for a qualifying incident during the window; jurors drawn from this pool's staked members adjudicate it. If approved claims exceed the funds in the pool, payouts are reduced proportionally — the mutual never pays more than it holds.
- End: after the conference, the claims submission period, and settlement of approved claims, the remaining pool balance is distributed to members and the mutual dissolves permanently. No funds remain.

## Status and links

- Status: pre-launch. No pool has run, no members exist, no payouts to show. The first pool is the build target, not a track record.
